segments.text: Engilis tarini umuman bilmasi izam, noldan otskun ichidi kundalik mauzulardi gaplashini baxishisis.
Bani techi razam 13-lik tajirbagi ege Engilis tarini oqtutsiman,
va 22-nchi, 23-nchi, 24-nchi Sintiabur kunlari Bepul online masterclass ta shkilashdirmakhtiman.
Ushbu masterclass-da noldan otskun ichidi kundalik mauzulardi gaplashini,
kunigi elikdigi cham sozlarini ansonyotlap, realxayotlashatish,
va ba ikli darajadigi sertifikatini alishdini samarali yollarini orgetaman.
Masterclass da qatna ish mundlaka bi pul, faqad xabar omslu qibasib royo qatna moting,
wa ya pqirgam kanalim gi qoshil balim.
